def workflow_status(obj, names):
    """ Show the status of one or more workflows.

    \b
    NAMES: The names, ids or job ids of the workflows that should be shown.
           Leave empty to show the status of all workflows.
    """
    if not names:
        names = [w.name for w in obj.workflows()]
    for name in names:
        obj.status_workflow(name)


def workflow_delete(obj, names):
    """ Delete one or more workflows.

    \b
    NAMES: The names, ids or job ids of the workflows that should be deleted.
           Leave empty to delete all workflows.
    """
    if not names:
        names = [w.name for w in obj.workflows()]
    for name in names:
        obj.delete_workflow(name)


def workflow_show(obj, names):
    """ Show one or more workflows.

    \b
    NAMES: The names, ids or job ids of the workflows that should be shown.
           Leave empty to show all workflows.
    """
    if not names:
        names = [w.name for w in obj.workflows()]
    for name in names:
        obj.show_workflow(name)


def workflow_create(obj, name, workflow):
    """ Create a new workflow.

    \b
    NAME: The name of the workflow.
    WORKFLOW: The workflow definition.
    """
    obj.create_workflow(name, workflow)


def workflow_update(obj, name, workflow):

    NAME: The name of the workflow.
    WORKFLOW: The workflow definition.
